integrity_notes: The all-modulus identity has a complete additive-character proof; finite exact computations are corroborative, not a replacement for that proof. Earlier equivalent formulas may exist; independent validation and definitive priority confirmation have not been performed.
limitations: Only the specific integral generator matrices (I_k | J_k-I_k) and (I_k | J_k-I_k | 1_k), k>=2, q>=2, with ordinary Hamming weight over Z/qZ. No assertion about arbitrary spike representations or decoding optimality.
title: Complete weight enumerators of two integral spike-code families
